podcast.title: Involvement in Copyright Case
podcast.body: As a partner to Albert Hammond Sr., Mike Hazelwood was involved in the copyright infringement lawsuit against Radiohead regarding "Creep." He now receives 25% of the writing credit for the song due to its similarities to "The Air That I Breathe." "Albert Hammond Sr. and his partner Mike Hazelwood each get 25% of the writing credit for Radiohead's Creepe."
